entries.title: One tick for every guide
entries.text: A gem, reforge, enchant or essence perk you tick once now counts in every guide that holds the same step.

entries.title: Shafting is the mining guide
entries.text: It replaces the old mining guide, splits every gemstone into Flawless first and then one Flawless to Perfect step per stone and place, and adds a Recombobulator step per piece.

entries.title: Essence shop and attributes
entries.text: Every level of the essence shop perks is its own step with its cost, and every attribute now shows what it does, including Freezing Spread with its current value.

entries.title: Icons
entries.text: Every pet and attribute shard has its picture, and the build loads the ones that are missing.

entries.title: A short tour
entries.text: On the first start, and once for everyone after this update, a six-step tour shows the guides, how ticking works and how to measure and read your stats.

entries.title: What's new
entries.text: After an update a sheet lists everything that changed since the version you saw last.

entries.title: Help in Settings
entries.text: Settings can start the tour again and show the full list of changes.

entries.title: Blaze stats in full
entries.text: Measure the whole Combat menu for Blaze, including Ferocity, Speed and Magic Find, and every ticked step now adds its item, reforge, enchant and set bonus stats.

entries.title: Gear options
entries.text: On the Power page you can set your Catacombs level, Crimson stars, potato books and the pet item; the Blaze pet doubles the books and lifts Blaze Armor.

entries.title: Nether Embodiment and Dominus
entries.text: The Blaze pet adds 10 % to the sum of your Combat and Misc stats, and the Crimson set gives its Ferocity and Swing Range from two pieces of one tier.

entries.title: Accessories and icons
entries.text: Accessories ticked after you measured count as a change since then, and the seven attribute shards without a head now show a Minecraft picture.

entries.title: Your pet floats next to you
entries.text: On the Overview your pet hovers beside your player; tap it to open the pet picker on that pet.

entries.title: Attributes in a sheet
entries.text: Tap an attribute to open a sheet with its icon, level buttons, effect now and next level, and the shards you still need.

entries.title: Attribute list with icons
entries.text: Every row shows the shard icon, level and a short effect line, and attributes you have not set are greyed out.

entries.title: Swipe works on every Stats page
entries.text: Swiping now also works on the HOTM page and goes on to Attributes and Power, or back, on every phone width.

entries.title: HOTM looks like the game
entries.text: Perks show coal, emerald and diamond, the Core and pickaxe abilities show blocks, and you can switch a perk off or select one ability.

entries.title: Pets with heads and perks
entries.text: The pet picker lists every pet with its head, stats and perks, and the Pet tag under your player jumps straight to it.

entries.title: HOTM, attributes and power
entries.text: Three new Stats pages let you enter your HOTM perks, attribute levels, power stone, Magical Power and tuning points; steps above your HOTM level are locked.

entries.title: Pick your pet
entries.text: Choose Bal, Glacite Golem, Goblin, Scatha, Snail or Mammoth; its stats count in your total, and perks that need a place or a mob are only listed.

entries.title: Changes since measurement
entries.text: The overview shows what each page moved since you measured your base, and your player appears with tags for pet and power.

entries.title: Swipe between Stats pages
entries.text: Swipe sideways to go from Overview to HOTM, Attributes and Power.

entries.title: No API key needed
entries.text: The guide app no longer asks for a Hypixel key or a profile; steps you ticked or that were recognised before stay ticked.

entries.title: Measure your base
entries.text: Type in your /stats once per area without armor, equipment, tool and pet, and the app adds the gear of your ticked steps.

entries.title: Stats overview
entries.text: A new purple Stats page shows base, gear and total per stat, and lists the effects that only count under a condition.

entries.title: Steady switch
entries.text: The Mining switch stays in place while you swipe or tap; only its marker slides along.

entries.title: No jump after a swipe
entries.text: The next guide already shows its open step while it slides in.

entries.title: Room for Mark done
entries.text: The step card is shorter: tap the cost line to see what the price is made of.

entries.title: Calmer start
entries.text: The start screen no longer flashes "No guide yet" while the guides load.

entries.title: Mark done animates and scrolls to the next step
entries.text: Ticking a step closes its card with a short animation and brings the next step fully into view.

entries.title: Swipe between Mining guides
entries.text: Swipe left and right to move between Gear progression and Shafting gear, and right from the first one to go home.

entries.title: A lighter swipe
entries.text: The screen now follows your finger exactly, keeps the speed of your flick and settles quickly, and guides open at once.

entries.title: Why a step is ticked
entries.text: Tap API on a step to see what the sync found for it; Settings list it for every guide under Detection report.

entries.title: Price source moved
entries.text: Where the prices come from is now in the notes behind the ⓘ and in Settings.

entries.title: Your step fits on screen
entries.text: A smaller header that folds to one line when you scroll keeps the Mark done card in view, and the notes now sit behind the ⓘ button.

entries.title: Blaze path is back
entries.text: The Blaze guide shows its path again; the notes above it had squeezed it out of view.

entries.title: Mining in one place
entries.text: Shafting gear is now part of the Mining guide, with a switch at the top and one card on the start page.

entries.title: Milestones
entries.text: Ranked guides show your progress on one ring with milestone marks, and how many steps and coins the next milestone still needs.

entries.title: The path is the ranking
entries.text: Each guide now sorts its open steps by what they bring per coin, also without a sync, and a step that costs far more than you have spent so far waits its turn.

entries.title: Shafting gear
entries.text: A new mining guide with a fixed order of gear for Mineshafts, with the gain of every step added up.

entries.title: One tick for all guides
entries.text: Ticking an item in one guide marks it in every guide that holds it.

entries.title: Swipes follow your finger
entries.text: The screen now moves with your finger, snaps into place when you let go, and springs back on a short swipe.

entries.title: Guides open on your step
entries.text: Opening a guide takes you straight to the step you are on, just below the header.

entries.title: Type in your stats
entries.text: Enter your /stats by hand under Stats, no API key needed; syncing with your own key is now an option in Settings.

entries.title: Swipe through a guide
entries.text: Swipe sideways to change tabs, and from the first tab back to your guides.

entries.title: Stats behind the profile button
entries.text: Your stats now open from the profile button at the top of the start page and of every guide.

entries.title: Limits in the chips
entries.text: A missed True Defense or Magical Power limit now shows as a red value in its chip.

entries.title: Source and coins left
entries.text: Each guide links its source again and shows the coins left to the end of the chapter and section.

entries.title: Your guides in their own app
entries.text: Follow your guides step by step, see the best value and compare your stats, each guide in its own colours.
